watchdog_ngo_searched: Democracy for the Arab World Now
adversarial_framing_finding: General/Macro Press sweep plus the RSS pre-filter surfaced an in-window Saudi geopolitical/security story (the Yemen/Houthi/Red Sea escalation). Checked multiple outlets on the same event: Al Jazeera (Qatari-funded) foregrounds Houthi claims of 54 Saudi air raids in 12 hours and civilian-harm allegations, an adversarial framing casting Saudi Arabia as an active combatant; The Guardian and Bloomberg report the territorial/market angles more neutrally. The adversarially-framed Al Jazeera item is included as its own Negative Articles bullet.
notes: Classic reputational material (executions, migrant labour, PIF/Wall Street pitch, Vision 2030/NEOM, sportswashing) is real and recent but dated 2026-09-08 or earlier, i.e. out of the 24-hour window; no in-window NGO statement surfaced. All in-window negative coverage clusters on the Saudi-Houthi/Yemen escalation (Al Jazeera, The Guardian, Middle East Eye, Bloomberg). Haaretz coverage of the same escalation was excluded per the Israeli-outlet hard rule; Saudi-owned outlets excluded per the source-eligibility rule.
